items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them
items.claim: A person can sin against God's commandments through ignorance

items.quote: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people
items.claim: An anointed priest can commit sin similar to that of the people

items.quote: then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering
items.claim: A priest who sins must bring a young unblemished bullock to the LORD as a sin offering
